title: Event Marketing Executive
summary: Event marketing executives plan and run a company's trade shows, conferences, dealer meets and brand activations (on-ground promotions). They sit in the marketing team, work closely with sales, and handle venues, vendors, budgets and the leads each event brings in.
dailyDuties: Plan the events calendar with sales and marketing heads
Book venues and brief AV, fabrication and hospitality vendors
Coordinate stall design and logistics for trade shows
Organise dealer meets and channel partner events
Track event budgets and spend against plan
Upload event leads to the CRM and report results

skills.expectation: Plan and run conferences, launches and customer events from brief to wrap-up
Manage trade show and exhibition participation, including stall design and fabrication
Organise dealer meets and channel partner events with the sales team
Source venues and manage AV, fabrication, hospitality and event agency vendors
Plan event budgets, control spend and report cost per lead and ROI
Capture leads at events, upload them to the CRM and drive follow-up
Run BTL brand activations such as mall, college or in-store activations
Brief vendors and coordinate sales, product and leadership teams on event day
Work with leads in Salesforce, HubSpot or Zoho CRM
Brief and manage event and creative agencies
Promote events on social media before and during the event
Keep sales heads and leadership aligned on the events calendar
